components.purpose: Keep project-local lifecycle behavior explicit and avoid heavy automatic hooks.
components.compensation_hypothesis: A documented hook admission policy prevents hidden automation and duplicate lifecycle wiring.
retirement_criteria: The project no longer needs a distinct lifecycle policy entry.

components.purpose: Define ownership, isolation, checker, verification, and handoff for delegated work.
components.compensation_hypothesis: Explicit worker contracts reduce parallel edit collisions and ambiguous completion.
retirement_criteria: Delegated work no longer crosses ownership or checking boundaries.

components.purpose: Keep reusable project guidance discoverable without growing root context indefinitely.
components.compensation_hypothesis: Progressive disclosure reduces context pressure while preserving specialized workflows.
retirement_criteria: Specialized project guidance fits safely in a smaller stable surface.

components.purpose: Keep feature, tool, and trace expectations repeatable.
components.compensation_hypothesis: Deterministic cases expose regressions that implementation and self-review can miss.
retirement_criteria: A case no longer represents an active invariant or observed failure.

components.purpose: Record admission, budgets, approval, and recovery for scheduled or event-driven work.
components.compensation_hypothesis: Explicit state and stop rules prevent unattended work from becoming an implicit runtime.
retirement_criteria: The project has no recurring, scheduled, event-driven, or resumable work.

components.purpose: Document optional connector purpose, permission, authentication, and evidence boundaries.
components.compensation_hypothesis: A reviewed tool surface reduces accidental permission growth and tool-selection ambiguity.
retirement_criteria: A connector has no active task class or duplicates a safer local capability.

components.purpose: Provide deterministic project checks, records, and maintenance commands.
components.compensation_hypothesis: Runnable scripts reduce repeated manual steps and make verification evidence reproducible.
retirement_criteria: A script duplicates a maintained command with equal safety and evidence.

components.purpose: Keep architecture, commands, testing, safety, state, and evidence guidance durable.
components.compensation_hypothesis: Reviewable docs prevent cross-session context loss and hidden operating conventions.
retirement_criteria: Guidance is superseded and all inbound references have moved.
